description: Ad/tracker blocking and privacy patches for the Column news app (com.columnapp.column).

patches.name: Block ads and trackers
patches.description: Blocks ad and tracker requests made by Column's web view. Column Premium (full articles, audio, Column AI) is validated server-side and is intentionally not modified.

patches.name: Disable Advertising ID
patches.description: Replaces the Google advertising identifier (GAID) with a fixed, non-unique value and enables limit ad tracking, so requests can no longer be tied back to this device.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer attribution
patches.description: Prevents the bundled AppsFlyer SDK from initialising and sending attribution data. May break referral / invite deep links.

release_notes:
Adds the **Disable Advertising ID** patch.

- **Block ads and trackers** (default on)
- **Disable Advertising ID** (default on, new): replaces the Google advertising identifier (GAID) with a fixed, non-unique value and enables limit ad tracking.
- **Disable AppsFlyer attribution** (opt-in)

Column Premium is issued by api.column.news and validated through RevenueCat. It is server-side and is intentionally not modified.
